notes.title: Big Demo Update
notes.content:
It's been a few weeks, but here we are!

Combat improvements


 Removed stamina. No more clunky out of stamina attacks.
 All enemies now have defined block chances that are not full 100%. They won’t block your attacks endlessly anymore.
 Enemies now cannot block while taunting, but they’ll try to dodge your attacks.
 Enemies can now use feints in an attempt to trick you before actually attacking.
 Smarter enemy dodging and more animation variety.
 Enemies now have a chance to counter attack right after dodging, blocking, getting hit or getting parried.
 General combat rebalance due to all the changes.


In general, combat is now more fast-paced and dynamic, and as a result enemies have to be smarter to keep up, and you'll need to keep your reflexes sharp.

Level content


 Added a small cave filled with goblins (and loot!) near the end of the demo level.
 Added a Stool weapon somewhere in the level. Try to find it!
 Added more enemies.


Other changes


 Improved overall lighting throughout the level.
 Tweaked/polished animations for all characters.
 Camera improvements.
 Better behavior near some walls.
 Better target lock behavior.
 Added a visible icon for tutorials so they are less likely to be missed accidentally.
 Performance improvements.
 Better controller handling.
 Weapons in inventory now display how much they stagger, instead of stamina cost



Bugfixes


 Fixed FPS limit and vsync settings
 Fixed full inventory warning when picking up drinks
 Other minor fixes



Thank you again for the great feedback, and keep it coming! We have some more fun improvements in mind to polish the whole experience before we continue working towards the full game.

notes.title: Demo Fixes - March 19
notes.content:
Small update today, but this should fix some of the issues players were having:


 Improved gamepad controls
 Added option to select resolution
 Added option to show fps
 Added option to select a gamepad type again, after the initial screen
 Fixed Save & Quit functionality
 Fixed keybinds not saving in settings


As always, thank you for playing the demo!

notes.title: Demo Update - March 18
notes.content:
We just passed 2000 demo downloads today, feedback is great and we'll keep trying to make it even better, thank you!

Today's updates:


 You can now parry with shields. Successful parries will not reduce the shield's durability.

https://i.imgur.com/ijGklSt.gif

 You can now save the game twice on each checkpoint.
 Running doesn't cost stamina anymore.
 Crash, audio and other bug fixes.


More improvements coming!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we just pushed another update. 

Today's improvements:


 More accurate hit detection and dismemberment
 New enemy dodge animation
 Added "OUT OF STAMINA" text indicator to make it more clear that it's not a heavy attack
 Fixed shield blocking animation
 Fixed enemy stagger not always triggering
 Improved enemy animations when they get hit
 Stamina now regenerates slowly while holding the shield up
 Fixed bug where enemies sometimes froze when dismembered


Everyone's feedback is helping tremendously, so keep it coming!

notes.title: Demo Hotfixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thank you so much for the great initial feedback for the Demo release of Crowned in Steel! 

There have been over a 1000 Demo installs over the first day, which is amazing. So many positive comments too, it really makes all the work so far worth it!

There have been some issues and bugs we found that have affected a number of players that we also just fixed in the latest build.


Bugfixes:


 Optimization improvement
 Stamina rebalancing
 Cursor issues
 Music stopping randomly
 Fixed slowmo on kill
 Fixed item drops



We'll keep working on more improvements over the next few days. Thank you again for all the feedback and keep it coming!

notes.title: Crowned in Steel Demo Release!
notes.content:
The time has come to finally release the demo for Crowned in Steel!

We've been pushing hard to get the build, and we feel it's finally ready for a broader release.

The demo includes Zulum Keep, the first level of the game, with around 1-2 hours of gameplay.

What's next

While most of the gameplay features have been implemented, there are still some very interesting things we'd like to include in the near future that we'll announce soon, and will be included in the demo as we get them out.

Other than that, for the full game we're planning:

- Additional, more open levels, each with a unique atmosphere.
- Arena Mode, allowing you to master the combat against increasingly difficult waves of enemies.

We'd love to hear your feedback as we continue working on the full game. Let us know your thoughts in our Discord.

Crush your enemies, struggle against fate and become the usurper!
